# Page reader fixtures

Pages for `test/page-reader-contract.test.mjs`, which loads every `*.html` here in Chromium,
injects each page reader adapter (`extension/page/reader.js`, `ButterPageReader`, isolated world;
`extension/page/reader-main.js`, `__butterPageReader`, MAIN world) and checks each fact the adapter
implements against the page's `data-expect-*` marks. The pages are written by hand from what ChatGPT's markup
is known to be (each file's comment names its sources), never generated by running Butter. One page,
`live-snapshot.html`, is the real ChatGPT DOM, sanitized
([notes/runs/2026-11-11-page-snapshot](../../../notes/runs/2026-11-11-page-snapshot/report.md));
its marks were decided from the markup the same way. Its `data-expect-block`,
`data-expect-preview-item` and `data-expect-loose-turn` marks, and those of the pages written before
them, were added by a one-off script that applied the rules below to the markup (an HTML parser, not
Butter), then reviewed by hand; the snapshot is otherwise byte for byte the capture.
`rules.html` holds one case per rule the other pages leave open. Prettier leaves these files alone
(`.prettierignore`), so a capture stays byte for byte.

Isolated reader (`reader.js`), and both readers for message identity:

| Mark                                | On                                                                                               | Means                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data-expect-answer="<message id>"` | each identified answer root                                                                      | `answersIn(document)` returns exactly these roots, in document order, with these ids                                                                                                                |
| `data-expect-question="<turn key>"` | each such answer root                                                                            | `turnKeyOf(root)` is the key of the turn it is in; leave it out when the answer is in no keyed turn (null)                                                                                          |
| `data-expect-para="<n>"`            | each paragraph                                                                                   | `n` is its ordinal within its enclosing `data-expect-answer` root: `paragraphsOf(root)` and `paragraphsIn(root)` equal exactly that root's marked paragraphs, which must run 0..k in document order |
| `data-expect-reply`                 | each reply (Ask in branch's reading)                                                             | `replies(document)` returns exactly these, in document order                                                                                                                                        |
| `data-expect-loose-turn`            | each loose turn: `[data-turn-key]`, `[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]` and `article` elements | `looseTurnOf(node)` is the closest one around the node                                                                                                                                              |

MAIN reader (`reader-main.js`, seek's reading), each checked in the document and in each
`[data-turn-key]` turn:

| Mark                       | On                                                                                          | Means                                                            |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data-expect-block`        | each child of an answer root, except `[data-wide-block]`, `[class*="TableFrame-"]` and `hr` | `blocksIn(scope)` returns exactly these, in document order       |
| `data-expect-preview-item` | each `[data-user-message-bubble]` and each child of an answer root                          | `previewItemsIn(scope)` returns exactly these, in document order |

An answer root is the `[data-markdown-text-style="assistant-message"]` element, or, when that
element holds a `[class*="DilResponseRoot"]` element, that Dil response root. The markdown columns
need no mark: by rule they are the `[data-markdown-text-style="assistant-message"]` elements, which
`columnsIn(scope)` returns in document order, `firstColumn(scope)` returns the first of, and
`hasAnswer(turn)` tells whether the turn has one.

Message identity, for each `[data-turn-key]` turn: the isolated `answersIn(turn)` ids are exactly
its `data-expect-answer` ids, in order, and the MAIN `turnMessageId(turn)` is the first of them, or
null when it has none.

A `data-expect-para` outside every `data-expect-answer` marks a paragraph of an answer that has no
message id yet: it is a paragraph, but its answer is not identified. Its `n` is not checked.

From the marks, every text node in `<body>` must map to:

- `paragraphOf(node)`: its closest `data-expect-para` element, or null;
- `answerOf(node)`: its closest `data-expect-answer` root and id, or null;
- `turnKeyOf(node)`, for a node inside a marked answer: that answer's `data-expect-question`;
- `replyOf(node)`: its closest `data-expect-reply` element, or null;
- `looseTurnOf(node)`: its closest `data-expect-loose-turn` element, or null.

`paragraphsIn(document)` returns every `data-expect-para` element in document order. Production
selectors must never match a `data-expect-*` attribute; the suite checks that the adapters' sources
don't name one.
